cards.name: Qdrant
cards.hint: Vector DB for RAG. Drop files in data/rag-input/ (with --profile rag) or upload via Open WebUI Documents tab.

cards.name: RAG Ingestion
cards.hint: Headless folder-watch embedder for Qdrant (no web UI). Health via container healthcheck. Logs: docker compose logs rag-ingestion
cards.notes: Portless headless worker: no HTTP check on purpose — the grid reads its true up/down from ops-api container health (routes_hub) instead of showing a neutral unknown.
